name: 10018 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10018 (New York) has 1,049 nonprofit organizations. 475 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 423 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10018 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10018 (New York) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 218 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
